chunks: And whatever was in it from Ḥārith Bayyāʿ al-Anmāṭ, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī Mājīlawayh—may Allah be pleased with him—from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, from his father, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Ḥārith Bayyāʿ al-Anmāṭ.

key_terms.بَيَّاعِ الْأَنْمَاطِ: seller of patterned carpets or furnishings; an identifying epithet
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates the author’s act of narration
key_terms.عَنْ أَبِيهِ: from his father; part of the lineage-based transmission link
key_terms.مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ: a transmitter in the chain of narration

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Ḥārith Bayyāʿ al-Anmāṭ in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Ḥārith Bayyāʿ al-Anmāṭ. Its significance lies in documenting the transmission route in hadith literature, helping identify the source chain for narrations in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh.
